<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the compound has a para‑substituted aromatic ring with a methoxy group (singlet at 3.81 ppm) and a side chain CH₂‑CH(CH₃)‑ attached to the ring (signals at 1.20, 2.85, 3.09 ppm). This matches the structure p‑methoxy‑phenyl‑CH₂‑CH(CH₃)‑, whose SMILES is “COc1ccc(cc1)CC(C)”.</thought>
<final_answer>COc1ccc(cc1)CC(C)</final_answer>
